info.name: Abnormal Security Client URL Rewrite API
Get URL rewrite click and clickthrough events

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page (default: 20, max: 100)

params.name: start
params.description: Start time of the time range to filter by (Unix timestamp)

params.name: end
params.description: End time of the time range to filter by (Unix timestamp)

params.name: recipient
params.description: Email address recipient of the email message to filter by

items.docs: Retrieve paginated click and clickthrough events for URL rewrites. Supports filtering by Unix time range, user email, and event type. Returns events where users clicked on rewritten URLs in email messages.
